text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And claiming victory in this fated showdown,
it's Daiwa Scarlet!!
(Waaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*... *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... haaah.
...Haaaah... couldn't match up. ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooh!!
That was amazing, so super hype!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Chan-chan, that was so close!
Seeing you run is seriously thrilling though!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, I'm so glad I came to watch~! Great job, Mar-chan! Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I did it!
I did it, I did it, yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it, damn it, DAMN IT...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Getting payed back and losing...
is so uncool! *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Having moved the hearts of so many,
the Oka Sho came to a close.

While waiting for Aston Machan to get ready to head home,
an email suddenly arrived.

Looking at the screen, it was a notification saying
her blog views had spiked sharply today—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's the "power of the Oka Sho"?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is good.
You were able to leave a mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I am relieved.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going over to say hello.

Is she going to talk with the other runners?
Seeing her leave before I could hear a reply, I decided to wait a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (...Even with my eyes closed, I can still hear it.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(...A wonderful sound, a wonderful sight.
I lost, but it was a great race.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, excellent, perfectly on track.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone. Please be sure to put it away properly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please take good care of it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...This is as far as Machan goes.
